create_InferenceClient: create an InferenceClient instance with an HF_TOKEN environment variable for API authentication
create_chat_completions: create a chat completion request using InferenceClient to send multimodal messages to a vision-language model
build_vlm_image_description: build a vision-language model call that describes an image from a URL using text and image_url message content types
run_multimodal_inference: run a non-streaming multimodal inference request against a Llama vision-instruct model with image and text inputs
parse_completion_response: parse the completion response to extract the model's generated message from choices[0].message
